title: xdrip+ isn't Responding
body: I'm using all Dexcom G5 stuff and was having problems with my last transmitter. I changed lots of settings trying to breath life back into the old transmitter, but finally gave up and moved to a new one. I had changed so much stuff, the new one wasnt working right also, so I finally cleared all settings (clear storage) and updated to the most current nightly for xdrip and set everything up from scratch. The transmitter and sensor now seem to finally be working OK, but xdrip is now throwing "isn't responding" errors every few minutes. I had originally updated to 20200420 version and have worked backwards all the way to the 20200129 version and still getting the isn't responding error. Any idea how to get it to quit doing this?

comments.body: I'm many newer versions and still having to deal with this xdrip+ isn't responding wait or close option. How can I get this fixed? It's working and I'm getting readings, it's just that about every 30 seconds it will pop up that warning no matter what app I'm in.

**.....which ones in particular? It's performing its job correctly bar the fact that it doesn't respond constantly.**

There are xDrip settings that are experimental.
There are different combinations of settings that give you readings.  But, just because one has readings doesn't mean their settings are optimal.

I use Dexcom, not Libre.
There is an xDrip setting, for Dexcom, called "Force G5 to UI Thread".  If you were using Dexcom and had that setting, I would ask you to disable it.

We have recommended settings for Dexcom.  I suppose there must be recommended settings for MiaoMiao.  Can you make sure you are using the recommended settings?

@renegadeandy I experienced a similar behavior on a Samsung Galaxy S4 mini after it ran for more than a year. It got worse over time. Than I enabled "Save Database Daily" and set "Glucose Retention" to 90 days. This shrunks the xDrip database and the GUI got responsive again. Maybe you can try this, too.
How old is your phone?

The question then becomes what is the recommended settings for MiaoMao @Navid200 .

@tolot27 nice tips. I have also now enabled Save Database Daily (can't see how this will help, the description doesn't really suggest what it does?).

I have also changed "Glucose Retention" to 90.

Phone is 2 years old. It's a pretty powerful device https://www.gsmarena.com/honor_9-8704.php

You can ask for recommended settings in the support channels, either in the facebook group or the Gitter room.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus

The number of individuals looking at these issues is much less than the number of people frequenting the support channels.

So far, every instance of this error I have seen has been addressed by adjusting xDrip settings to only what is absolutely required.

There was a Dexcom collector case where changing all the Bluetooth and G5/G6 Debug settings to recommended settings stopped the issue.

@getut Are you still experiencing this problem?
If yes, would you please ensure your settings match the following?
https://github.com/Navid200/xDrip/wiki/G5-Recommended-Settings
Unless we can recreate the problem, I see no way any of us can open a PR and fix it.
